not_a_trial_freeze: Neither this config nor a fit artifact is a full trial freeze.

contract.hash_of: raw UTF-8 blob at the issuing commit

self_contained: empirical_policy_v2.py imports no project module; its artifact identities cover exactly its own source and this config

hash_conventions.raw: sha256 of raw UTF-8 bytes of a file or text
hash_conventions.object: sha256 of json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')
hash_conventions.artifact_identities: source_sha256/config_sha256 are raw-byte hashes of empirical_policy_v2.py and this config

root_shapes.verified_common: {root_id, state: null, common_outcome, invalid_disposition} (requires a verified common law outside the API)

unavailable_history_rule: keeps its original weight w; marginal interval [0,1] for every policy; adds 0 to the lower and w to the upper criterion of every map; no imputed state, cell, action, grade or primitive; not a shared outcome; no contrast returned
observed_incomplete: a known history with has_incomplete true is an observed INCOMPLETE state, never reinterpreted as unavailable
weights: w_gi = 1/(G*m_g) over all supplied families and planned roots, including verified-common and unavailable-history roots
b1_rule: RETHINK iff J(constant RETHINK) > J(constant PATCH), else PATCH
d_rule: per known-history cell, strictly larger weighted lower sum; tie or unseen -> b1
all_unavailable: PATCH everywhere, lower 0, upper 1, no observed support, no efficacy inference
limits: J(d) >= J(b1) is exact algebra on the lower criterion, not correct ranking, improvement or an estimate on the latent quality target; not MAR
